title: Spring of Mountain — Japanese painting of a pine and waterfall phone wallpaper
alt: Vertical iPhone background from a Japanese painting: a pine leaning in from the top with dark blue-green needle clusters on knotted brown branches, a small white bird among them, an ochre cliff behind, and a bright green stream folding over a waterfall past wet black rocks
